title: Benchmarking Causal Study to Interpret Large Language Models for Source Code

bias_targets.methodology: Using Structural Causal Models (SCM) and statistical techniques such as propensity score matching, stratification, and Inverse Probability Weighting (IPW) to control for code-based confounders (e.g., prompt size, lines of code, token counts, number of white spaces) to accurately measure the causal effect of prompt engineering on LLM code generation performance.

Curating novel benchmark testbeds by strictly filtering GitHub repositories by specific date ranges to prevent data snooping (evaluating on training data), and explicitly removing duplicated code snippets using Jaccard similarity.
